dataset.abstract: A monthly sampling programme was carried out in 1975 of an intertidal population of Ficopomatus enigmaticus at Greenhithe, Kent. Greenhithe is on the south side of the Thames Estuary, and the study site (O.S. TQ 59367548), beneath a disused jetty belonging to Empire Paper Mills, is immediately opposite the large power station at West Thurrock, and 33-8 km below London Bridge, the normal limit for sea water ingression.
